unit.sourceText: その風景には、悲しさも、痛みも、なかった。

translations.text: 那片景色中，没有悲伤，也没有痛楚。

sourceAdaptations.basis: Root reviewed independent candidate05, with canonical shortcut contract, full-stage text search and save-rejection phase corrections. No product source or pixels feed expected.

adaptations.basis: Root reviewed correction: typed desired/effective and draft use canonical Alt+Super+H/P; only presentation formatter renders Apple glyphs.
Root reviewed correction: event stage is free text against full server dataset, never finite options inferred from loaded records.
Rust ScopedPreferences supports true scalar field masks plus hud.compact/hud.alwaysOnTop values; candidate05 README only described original demonstration keys. No merge authority moved to UI.
Root explicitly selected failed saveError plus failed native receipt/effective old, preserving dirty draft and action error; source uses approved ls-boundary/ls-error-text styles, not product CSS.
Root approved explicit distinction between base fields and compact effective text sizes; same semantic explanatory sentence shown independently.
Root approved scope disabled until user saves/discards dirty draft; presentation follows typed dirty and prevents scope contamination.
Root approved preservation of existing immutable unit copy and visible sourceSummary-derived origin; not inferred from gameId.

Root approved correction: typed follow=true places original sorted received records at their independently measured latest extent; no product scroll number or PNG consulted. follow=false preserves fixed viewport.
Root approved independent receiving-caption mapping, retaining active/paused/opening/terminal distinctions; this fixture explicitly represents active selected-source receiving.

Root independently corrected candidate05 missing ls-button primitive. New settings actions reuse approved C02 ls-button12px/28px/4x11 and apply disabled is derived from typed dirty. Original bare-button candidate retained, no styling taken from product pixels.
Root approved session consumer displays typed session identity, not the offline candidate/PID replay. Candidate consumer keeps complete CID/PID, title/Bottle/EXE/frame/time/identity metadata remain.

Root independently approved RW11 error semantic priority: candidate05 ls-boundary secondary color overrode earlier ls-error-text. Explicit combined selector restores failure color using approved token, never product pixels. Original candidate05 and previous PNG retained.

Root approved shared policy: more than32 logical pixels above independently measured latest pauses follow and exposes return-to-latest; typed follow=true still anchors first load at latest. Reference listens only to its own design DOM scroll and records each variant follow condition; no actual scrollTop or PNG used.

corrections.evidence: Direct Playwright of approved index.html?scenario=settings&theme=dark at display category: native range height28,padding5px8px,minHeight0. styles.css generic input cascade supplies padding/border; native-content.css contains no claimed selector. Earlier proposed exclusion did not match and was never applied to expected output. Root withdrew it and approved matching product to complete original cascade.

Candidate21 static native clone intentionally stripped scripts, so follow render had no LunaIcons and omitted check/pause SVG. Producer now loads the already approved independent icons.js before binding, never imports product icons. Candidate21 failed images retained.
